history_policy: This version hash-inherits every V5 decision and adds the owned Promise, async-function, and microtask-checkpoint family. Any later workload, boundary, jobs, checksum, metric, or acceptance change creates another version.
change: Moves promises_async_microtasks from deferred to implemented. Both public runners time the workload invocation, their normal host microtask checkpoint, and a generic post-checkpoint checksum read; synchronous historical rows retain their original one-evaluation path.

implemented_families_append.surface: Promise reactions, chained reactions, thenable assimilation, and two-stage async/await continuation draining

completion.timed_boundary: Invocation, the public runner's normal end-of-script microtask checkpoint, and an exact checksum read after the checkpoint are timed together on both engines.

implemented_families_append.anti_specialization: Base and variant traverse the scheduling call graph in opposite order while retaining the same four independent Promise/async continuation shapes. The exact input multiset, callback count, job count, work, and final commutative checksum remain equal.
